answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trusted mass from vetted seeds through walks of at most L steps; oasis, meadow, and ridge are regions, not identities. An adversarial Sybil cluster behind a sparse external cut has low conductance, so little seed-derived mass reaches it within L steps. With normalized transitions and per-identity vote caps, its aggregate voting weight is bounded by incoming cut flow, not by the number of fabricated nodes.
